name: Aman Sharma
summary:
Qualified Chartered Accountant (May 2025) with experience in statutory audits, financial reporting, and Ind AS compliance,
including exposure to audit of Nifty 50 listed company.
company_details: 1. Assurance Senior @ Ernst and Young GDS LLP (Sep 2025 - May 2026) [conf 0.98, review=False]
2. Article Assistant @ B R Maheswari & Co LLP (Mar 2022 - Mar 2025) [conf 0.98, review=False]

responsibilities: Performed correlation (3 Way), trial balance tie-outs and analytical procedure to ensure accuracy of financial reporting.
Preparation of Letter of representation and Audit report.
Working on trade payables and trade receivables cutoff analysis and test of details.
Understand the procedures of Global audits.

Statutory Audit: o Executed Statutory audit & Limited review of 3rd largest cement manufacturers company having turnover more than 23000+ Crores which was part of Nifty 50 Index wherein I reviewed internal financial controls (Section 143) and Ind As Compliances in preparation of financial statements, Consolidation adjustments as per Ind AS 110, Analytical review of expenses, Ledger scrutiny (100+) etc. & CARO reporting (Clause 1,2,11,13,21). o Conducted Analysis of Ratios, Variances, Trends, and Prepared Financial Statements as per AS & Schedule- III of Companies Act 2013 of manufacturing, retail and service industry clients. o Worked on area such as Investment, Property plant and Equipment, External commercial borrowing, leases and have gained practical implications of INDAS such as 109, 16, 116 etc.

Accounting and Financial Reporting: o Preparation of financial statements (30+) including Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow statements, notes to accounts and significant accounting policies in accordance with applicable AS and Ind AS.
Taxation: o Conduct Tax audit (Section 44AB) of listed, unlisted, MSME, partnership firms and others under Form 3CA, 3CB and 3CD. o GST return filing (GSTR 1 and 3B) and GST audit (GSTR 9 and 9C).

Client Interaction & Documentation: o Liaised with clients for data collection, clarification of audit queries, and compliance matters. Maintained proper documentation and working papers for audit assignments.
